dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged perimeters composed of high-intensity silver-white pixels surrounding circular or semi-circular dark charcoal centers; prominent 'O' and 'C' structures on the mid-dorsal region exhibit sharp gradient transitions from dark interior to light exterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of solid high-intensity pixels observed along the lower lateral line and near the front flipper base; these lack internal dark voids and present as dense, non-geometric light patches.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal 'O' shaped annuli form an obtuse triangular spatial relationship; centroids of the primary lateral ring clusters form a staggered linear chain along the longitudinal mid-body axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-saturation orange artificial identification tag is attached to the pelt on the upper mid-dorsal surface.
